notice: Vehicle profiles describe common Indian goods-vehicle CLASSES used for household shifting, with typical cargo-body sizes quoted by transport operators. They are NOT manufacturer specifications and are not verified for any particular vehicle, body builder or fleet. Cargo-body size, payload and permitted load vary by make, model and body. Confirm the real dimensions and payload with the transport provider before relying on a recommendation.

vehicles.name: Mini goods vehicle
vehicles.description: Small covered goods vehicle (Tata Ace / Chhota Hathi class). Usually suits a studio or a few items.
vehicles.classExamples: Tata Ace, Mahindra Jeeto and similar small commercial vehicles

vehicles.name: Pickup truck (8 ft)
vehicles.description: 8 ft pickup with a covered load body (Bolero Pickup class). Often used for a 1 BHK move.
vehicles.classExamples: Mahindra Bolero Pickup, Tata Intra V30, Ashok Leyland Dost and similar 8 ft pickups

vehicles.name: 10 ft closed truck (LCV)
vehicles.description: 10 ft closed-body light commercial vehicle (Tata 407 / Eicher Pro 2049 class). Often used for a 1 BHK or a small 2 BHK local move.
vehicles.classExamples: Tata 407, Eicher Pro 2049 and similar 10 ft light trucks

vehicles.name: 14 ft closed truck (LCV)
vehicles.description: 14 ft closed-body light commercial vehicle (Tata 407 / Eicher 14 ft class). Often used for a 2 BHK local move.
vehicles.classExamples: Eicher Pro 14 ft, Tata 14 ft LPT and similar light trucks

vehicles.name: 17 ft closed truck
vehicles.description: 17 ft closed-body medium truck. Often used for a large 2 BHK or a 3 BHK move.
vehicles.classExamples: Eicher 17 ft and similar 17 ft medium trucks

vehicles.name: 19 ft closed truck
vehicles.description: 19 ft closed-body truck. Often used for a 3 to 4 BHK move or long-distance shifting.
vehicles.classExamples: 19 ft medium and heavy-duty closed trucks

vehicles.name: 22 ft closed truck
vehicles.description: 22 ft closed-body heavy truck. Often used for a large 3 to 4 BHK home, a villa or long-distance shifting.
vehicles.classExamples: Tata 22 ft and similar 22 ft heavy trucks
